section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1982
title: Volume of Suicides in States/Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities The volume of suicides per lakh of population for India as a whole was 6 · 54 and for the states/UTs. and Metropolitan Cities it was 6 · 48 10 · 35 and 8 · 26 respectively. Thus for the states as a whole it was slightly less than the all India average but for the U.Ts. and the Metropolitan cities it was more than the all-India average of 6 · 54 per lakh of population. Among, the states, the highest volume of suicides was recorded by Tripura (26 · 87) followed by Kerala (18 · 16), Karnataka (14 · 29), West Bengal (12 · 63) and Tamil Nadu (11 · 37). The volume of suicides registered by the rest of the states was less than (10 · 00) and the states of Assam (8 · 57) and Orissa (8 · 77) also recorded the higher volume of suicides than the All-India average of (6 · 54). The lowest volume of suicides was recorded by Jammu and Kashmir (0 · 37) and Nagaland (0 · 65). Among the U.Ts. the highest volume of suicides was recorded by Pondicherry (58 · 28) followed by A&N Islands (38 · 30) while it was the lowest (1 · 44) in Mizoram. Among the Metropolitan cities Bangalore toped the list with a volume of (28 · 92) suicides per lakh of population followed by Nagpur (16 · 13) while it was the lowest in Calcutta (1 · 25). The details are presented in Table-II. TABLE 2 Incidence of Suicides, Volume of Suicides per Lakh of Population during 1982
